description: Batch company enrichment from hiring data: give up to 10 company names, websites or job-board URLs, with optional title, location and remote filters. Each company gets its ATS and careers page, open and matching roles, remote share, top teams, the newest matching jobs, and postings added and removed in the last 7 and 30 days with a growing, steady or shrinking signal, from our crawl history of 18,000+ boards. Ranked by matching jobs, with a one-line summary. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

companies.description: Up to 10 company names (stripe), websites (openai.com) or job-board URLs, comma-separated (a JSON array also works)

jobsPerCompany.description: Newest matching jobs listed per company, 0 to 10 (default 3)

location.description: Keep jobs whose location or country contains this text (london, remote)

remote.description: true keeps only jobs marked remote

title.description: Keep jobs whose title contains this text; comma-separate alternatives (engineer,developer)

name: companies_hiring_scan

notes.description: string, e.g. "From each company's public job board. source index: our cra

summary.description: string, e.g. "3 of 3 companies found; 3 with matching jobs. Most: openai

title: Companies hiring scan
